reviews.classification: full prompt/helper/map review; actual delivery authority and unrun behavior boundaries retained
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual full review covers all284 original lines and R1–R6 local reconciliation. This is an October13 execution prompt with historical direct authorization, not a current instruction to implement another cue, start a worker or run the file. The full current checkpoint and presentation connection section were also read: a bounded source implementation/18focused/rebuilt native Running/Weightlifting cue route already returned, with literal-file import/OS-hidden-tab/failure/extra visual gaps separately open there. No further claim about linked report or current runtime follows.

F2: Preserve discovered existence, learned facts, permanent unlock, present eligibility and user-hidden layout as different owners. A shared Stances panel must retain baseline controls; the picker does not enumerate individual skill names, so do not fabricate a hidden-skill-picker requirement. Admission before categories/search/counts/accessibility/effects metadata matters at actual exposures. Native thresholds stay native; source first-level reveal is reference behavior, not a defect or a numerical threshold to copy. XP-overcount/tool-counter/RNG/hover/timer observations remain supplied reference claims at their pinned revision, not newly reproduced current bugs.

F3: R4 qualifies the generic durable-first wording: transactional craft waits for actual durable publication and drops pending cue on rollback; ordinary synchronous XP keeps its actual autosave timing rather than a new per-XP save. Presentation consumes typed actual settlement, not prose/DOM/color inference, and cannot grant rewards, alter RNG or settle gameplay. Restore seeds known baseline without replay, distinct from real new discovery; hidden-tab/dedup/cancel/coalescing cannot delay settlement. Future transform/time/fracture/erasure/fourth-wall vocabulary remains optional source/means-qualified design, not new fake powers or a tier registry.

F4: Off/reduced/static readable equivalents, independent optional sound, known text/color semantics, focus/scroll/layout and observer attribution stay useful. A bluff or rumor must not become certified fact because it receives a strong visual. A bounded renderer test is not earned native discovery, and fixture settings after an earned transition differ from synthesizing the transition. The prompt's strict natural-only route is its historical selected proof, not a universal ban on AD43 named fixtures. Current AD42 makes human taste optional, and current desktop/AD36 target checks supersede old1366/1440/150%-proxy matrices. The October24 retired one-realm/one-prestige gate and later Proto23 code permission supersede the prompt's old restrictions where applicable; present PROJECT retains push authority. No linked served bytes, old localhost handle, screenshot, native save, runtime, source acquisition, commit or push was revalidated or executed.

reviews.classification: full prompt/helper/map review; actual delivery authority and unrun behavior boundaries retained
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual full review covers all125 original lines: five exports, itinerary/stock shapes and exact glue, durable Features boundary, omission/revision policy, five pinned-source rows, checks/hashes and later rule-fit qualification. Callable/imported source is explicitly implemented-unverified here. Syntax/import enumeration did not execute a constructor/preview or test behavior, and hashes of observed dependencies do not establish native admission. No current source or upstream Git object was newly inspected or executed by this review.

F2: Preserve absolute per-command completion targets and first unfinished step; existing manual completions do not prove execution order. This read-only projection is not a saved mixed queue, accepted obligation or scheduler. Features workPlans remains the named durable owner; no copied completion cursor or second stock policy. A transient stock phase carries hysteresis only when caller retains it; missing control returns idle and lower0 cannot activate from zero. A matching actual frozen job suppresses another start, while disabling future starts preserves its paid terms/time. Identity/revision/sequence/participant guards bind one actual command before durable publication.

F3: Actual inventory binding, exact deterministic batch and finite budget differ from geometry/funding. Strict lower trigger, upper whole-batch refusal, maxStarts lifetime-of-this-authored-request and existing paid jobs are this API's contract, not a player's universal lifetime limit under AD22. maxStartsByBand is room, not an automatic program count; count1 cannot be multiplied without a new real batch quote/settlement route. Unknown executable costs stay null while declarations may include unresolved formulas; workMinutes excludes travel/waits/interruptions/future support. Conditional expected output is not delivery if support later fails/refunds. Current ACR rules preserve phase settlement/concurrency/committed terms without new autonomous enrollment.

F4: Internal rows need the root's actual public/knowledge projection and should not expose raw owner objects, secret future steps or counts. A blocked unbuilt/future step is not fictional impossibility. Definition revision invalidates transient requests rather than silently changing command meaning. Existing individual commands/jobs remain when helper is omitted; old-save deferral is historical scope and cannot waive compatibility for selected saved-policy changes. Pin/hash checks of five upstream objects are attributed bounded source text, not executed whole-repository proof; shared lineage is not independent mechanism novelty. No copied upstream source, dependency, download, source qualification or broad planner framework follows. Root/native/UI/build/failure/save gates stay distinct from this worker's import check. No runtime, worker, migration, deletion, commit or push.

F2: DOD1 actual places/travel/time/return; DOD2 independently funded work/escrow/collection; DOD3 installed measurement/sample/message/response/received knowledge; DOD4 exact remedies/loan/learner/material/crop/native cooking; DOD5 mature result/ending/public-paid versus private closure/changed return and save-version compatibility remain distinct connected requirements. No registry count,43newcommands/37controls or fourteen/eighteen/five packet action count proves those journeys. AllWC-G fields marked delivered have the same source/build scope; they do not close the missing behavior/failure proof.

F3: Registry1059commands/48controllers/18conditions/8worlds/4plans/51sources and no newworld/prestige describe d405e2c1a0e3, not today's registry or campaign denominator. Normal primitive fact/body/loan/stamped-item validators and explicit simulation5 admission are reported code/compatibility design, not executed old-save/import proof. Native original opening and exact carrier/material identity remain meaningful; a source-reviewed same-body/clock/custody boundary is not a new universal law.

F4: Existing owner backlog explicitly leaves unit/gameplay/browser/save/reload/import/failure/regression/keyboard/director work unrun. Current AD43 labels selected runtime below floor until its actual required checks, while AD42 makes human review optional and current PROJECT keeps Frontier as test bed, not a new depth priority. Do not convert its only-later-acceptance wording into current native completeness or a demand to run every old acceptance family for this documentation pass. Wider novel/all-world/body/time/attack/ecology/death depth stays conditional.
